fields.label: Student identity and group
fields.help: Enter GROUP | Surname | GivenName. Use your student identity only; no identity-document numbers. These three parts propose the PDF filename.

fields.label: Package/source identity
fields.help: Record S08 v1.1.0, PACKAGE_ID.txt and your assessed file identity. Distinguish student source from any teaching preview.

fields.label: Actual Node/npm and execution environment
fields.help: Copy actual node --version and npm --version output plus OS and browser/version where used. Do not copy the prescribed pin as an observation.

fields.label: SOURCE_REASONING / MODEL / REACT_TEST / REACT_BROWSER / NOT_EXECUTED
fields.help: Choose the strongest actual evidence class represented. MODEL and SOURCE_REASONING are not actual React execution. Per-check classes still belong in the traces.

fields.label: Environment block or qualification limit
fields.help: State the actual block or write NONE for no known block. No field value qualifies the environment.

sections.title: 1. Identity and evidence class
sections.intro: Record actual work; use explicit pending labels for unfinished evidence. Never convert a model result into a React observation.

fields.label: Prediction before the selected individual action
fields.help: Record before your selected action: fixture, input, predicted state/output and a falsifying observation. A reconstructed prediction must be labelled retrospective.

fields.label: Vanilla responsibility to React owner map
fields.help: Map initialisation, input, items, filter, counts, events, rendering and storage to owners. Include all four required child responsibilities.

fields.label: Exact initial items and storage fixture
fields.help: Paste exact initial items and stored JSON or the explicit absence. Use the same valid fixture for both compared implementations. State the storage namespace.

fields.label: App.jsx-only assessment diff boundary
fields.help: Record the assessed path projects/p01/student/src/App.jsx and boundary-check result. Preview changes are separate and do not enlarge the permitted student edit.

sections.title: 2. Prediction and ownership
sections.intro: Record actual work; use explicit pending labels for unfinished evidence. Never convert a model result into a React observation.

fields.label: P01 implementation status and unfinished work
fields.help: Keep IN_PROGRESS until the full P01 contract is evidenced. An 18-minute implementation segment is not project completion.

fields.label: Add/toggle/remove/filter trace with input and output
fields.help: Give named steps for trim/blank add, toggle, remove, all/remaining/read counts, empty view and semantic controls; include actual outputs and evidence locators.

fields.label: Initialisation and filter-only storage observation
fields.help: Distinguish initial writes from later events. State exact complete-array output and the filter-only write count from your actual check.

fields.label: ID uniqueness and reload evidence or explicit gap
fields.help: State actual add-after-reload evidence with source/preview path and IDs, or label the gap. Fresh allocation cannot repair duplicate IDs already stored or guarantee concurrent-tab uniqueness.

fields.label: Baseline command/name/result and evidence
fields.help: Final candidate format: ACTUAL_RECORDED: PASS; command; named checks; evidence locator. Otherwise use NOT_EXECUTED/BLOCKED/FAIL with cause.

fields.label: Objective command/named failure class/result
fields.help: Record all six canonical P01 objective checks separately from additional checks. Use ACTUAL_RECORDED: PASS only for actual execution.

fields.label: Regression command/result
fields.help: Record canonical regression command, result and locator. It is not a substitute for a React objective or reload test.

fields.label: Build command/output or explicit not-run status
fields.help: Record actual build command/output and locator. A build does not prove behavioural parity. No installation is part of this form.

fields.label: Actual browser observations or pending
fields.help: Record actual browser/OS, selected steps, visible outcomes and locator. Include controls, initialisation/reload and storage limits. MODEL is not a browser result.

fields.label: Sanitised bounded diff and unchanged-source check
fields.help: Paste the bounded App.jsx diff or complete changed file with locator. Add pages in the DOCX route for long evidence. Do not paste a private reference solution.

sections.title: 3. P01 complete implementation evidence
sections.intro: Record actual work; use explicit pending labels for unfinished evidence. Never convert a model result into a React observation.

fields.label: Predicted debounce/cleanup/publication timeline
fields.help: Before execution, draw old/new timing, debounce, cleanup and publication expectations with a named fake.

fields.label: Diagnosis tied to weak evidence and exact source
fields.help: Tie your diagnosis to exact weak-source lines; separate missing-signal TypeError from lifecycle failures.

fields.label: SearchPanel.jsx-only bounded patch excerpt and identity
fields.help: Paste your SearchPanel.jsx-only patch/explanation and file identity. Keep generated evidence/tests unchanged.

fields.label: Old/new/short-query/unmount evidence and ordering
fields.help: Record call order, timer steps, signals and settlements for old/new, shortened query and unmount. Label source/model versus actual test/browser.

fields.label: Which guards and which fake were used
fields.help: Name the exact active/numeric/abort conditions and whether the fake settles after abort. Removing one guard need not create a race.

fields.label: Unexpected error identity and sanitised display observation
fields.help: Record the unexpected error identity given to the logger and the sanitised visible message. Use only fabricated test data, never secrets.

fields.label: Named P03 baseline/objective/regression/build results
fields.help: Final candidate format contains BASELINE: PASS; OBJECTIVE: PASS; REGRESSION: PASS; BUILD: PASS; with commands, evidence IDs and ACTUAL_RECORDED. Extra checks are separate and may remain explicitly unqualified.

fields.label: Untested edge case including callback or runtime limit
fields.help: Record omitted-callback, unmount, accessibility and runtime checks not performed. Do not infer coverage from a test title.

sections.title: 4. Required P03 portfolio
sections.intro: Record actual work; use explicit pending labels for unfinished evidence. Never convert a model result into a React observation.

fields.label: ACTUAL_RECORDED / PENDING / separately authorised alternative
fields.help: ACTUAL_RECORDED means a real bounded exchange. Synthetic practice remains PENDING unless a prior, separate teacher authorisation specifies an alternative.

fields.label: Relevant sanitised prompt actually used
fields.help: Keep only the sanitised prompt actually used. Ask about one ownership/effect claim, not a complete implementation.

fields.label: Relevant claim actually received
fields.help: Keep the relevant answer extract and tool/date reference. Do not paste the full conversation or label synthetic text as received.

fields.label: Independent method and evidence locator
fields.help: State your independent method, actual result and evidence locator, not agreement between two AI answers.

fields.label: ACCEPTED / REJECTED / PARTIALLY ACCEPTED / UNKNOWN
fields.help: Assess the claim, not the student. PARTIALLY_ACCEPTED is the stored code for PARTIALLY ACCEPTED. UNKNOWN is not PASS or an automatic waiver.

fields.label: Correction justified by the witness
fields.help: State the correction supported by the witness, or explain why no change is justified.

fields.label: Scope and unresolved uncertainty
fields.help: State what your check does not establish; an honest uncertainty can remain even after the check.

sections.title: 5. Actual Gemini claim and independent review
sections.intro: Record actual work; use explicit pending labels for unfinished evidence. Never convert a model result into a React observation.

fields.label: One ownership/identity lesson for the semester project
fields.help: Explain one ownership/identity/lifecycle lesson for the semester project in your own words.

fields.label: Remaining work and smallest next check
fields.help: List remaining required work and smallest next check. Use NONE only when no required work remains. Optional P02 may remain undone.

fields.label: Locator list for snippets/screenshots/logs embedded in the PDF
fields.help: List only evidence embedded in this PDF: section/page/label. File paths alone do not embed screenshots or logs. Use the DOCX route to insert images.

sections.title: 6. Transfer, remaining work and evidence index
sections.intro: Record actual work; use explicit pending labels for unfinished evidence. Never convert a model result into a React observation.

fields.label: Truthful individual work, actual observations distinguished from expectations
fields.help: I performed the individual work described, distinguish actual observations from expectations/models and have not invented an AI exchange. This is not a teacher approval.

fields.label: Prior explicit authorisation if any; absence gives no exception
fields.help: Default NONE. A separately authorised alternative must use AUTHORISATION: teacher=...; date=YYYY-MM-DD; scope=execution/gemini/both; reference=...; replacement=... . This form cannot grant or authenticate permission.

fields.label: Draft/final candidate and local PDF review status
fields.help: Before saving select FINAL_CANDIDATE_NOT_YET_SAVED. After reopening and inspecting the saved PDF record LOCAL_PDF_REVIEWED_NOT_MOODLE_RECEIPT and regenerate as needed. Neither state establishes Moodle submission.

sections.title: 7. Declaration and submission boundary
sections.intro: Record actual work; use explicit pending labels for unfinished evidence. Never convert a model result into a React observation.
